easy_fields.name: NWPU-RESISC45
easy_fields.creator: Northwestern Polytechnical University (NWPU), Gong Cheng, Junwei Han, Xiaoqiang Lu
easy_fields.citeAs: Gong Cheng, Junwei Han, and Xiaoqiang Lu. Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification: Benchmark and State of the Art. Proceedings of the IEEE, 2016.
easy_fields.description: NWPU-RESISC45 is a large-scale, publicly available benchmark dataset for Remote Sensing Image Scene Classification (RESISC), created by Northwestern Polytechnical University. It contains 31,500 images across 45 scene classes, with 700 images per class. The dataset features significant variations in translation, spatial resolution, viewpoint, object pose, illumination, background, and occlusion, and aims to provide high within-class diversity and between-class similarity.
